Request: For each city, find the pincode with the highest total amount_inr of orders created in October 2026 (all statuses) and that pincode's share of the city's October total. Return columns city, pincode, share (rounded to 3 decimals).

reference.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT city, pincode, SUM(amount_inr) gmv FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01' AND created_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY city, pincode), r AS (SELECT city, pincode, gmv, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY gmv DESC) rk, SUM(gmv) OVER (PARTITION BY city) city_gmv FROM t) SELECT city, pincode, ROUND(gmv/city_gmv,3) AS share FROM r WHERE rk=1

Request: For each customer who has at least one RTO order, take their FIRST RTO order (earliest created_at) and the next order that customer created after it (any status). Ignore customers with no later order. Group by the payment_mode of that first RTO order and return columns payment_mode, avg_gap_days (average days between the two created_at timestamps, rounded to 1 decimal).

reference.sql: WITH fr AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(created_at) AS rto_at FROM orders WHERE status='RTO' GROUP BY customer_id), fx AS (SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.rto_at, o.payment_mode, (SELECT MIN(o2.created_at) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id=fr.customer_id AND o2.created_at > fr.rto_at) AS next_at FROM fr JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=fr.customer_id AND o.created_at=fr.rto_at AND o.status='RTO') SELECT payment_mode, ROUND(AVG(julianday(next_at)-julianday(rto_at)),1) AS avg_gap_days FROM fx WHERE next_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_mode
